title: Chelsea fined £10m but avoid suspended points deduction
summary: Chelsea has been handed a £10 million fine by the FA for breaching agent payment rules spanning 2009 to 2022, but avoided a suspended points deduction that could have severely impacted their league standing. The substantial penalty reflects the scope and duration of the regulatory violations discovered.
content: Chelsea are fined £10m by the Football Association for breaching rules relating to payments to agents between 2009 and 2022.

zh.title: 切尔西被罚1000万英镑但避免禁赛处罚
zh.summary: 切尔西因违反2009年至2022年期间的中介费支付规则，被英足总罚款1000万英镑，但避免了可能严重影响其联赛排名的禁赛处罚。这项重大处罚反映了所发现监管违规的范围和持续时间。

title: Hearts boss targets another title tilt despite style change
summary: Heart of Midlothian manager Wouter Vrancken aims to mount another title challenge this season following last term's strong Scottish Premiership campaign, even as his squad must adjust to a significantly different tactical approach. The adaptation presents both a challenge and an opportunity for the Edinburgh club.
content: Heart of Midlothian head coach Wouter Vrancken is looking to replicate last season's strong Scottish Premiership showing despite his players having to adapt to "a totally different style of play".

zh.title: 心脏队主帅尽管改变风格仍以争冠为目标

title: Why women's football is first casualty of Fifa plans
summary: Former England defender Anita Asante has warned that women's football could become a major casualty of FIFA president Gianni Infantino's upcoming plans. Her comments highlight concerns about how proposed changes to football governance may disproportionately affect the women's game.
content: Fifa's president Gianni Infantino's plans will make women's football "the first casualties" according to former England defender Anita Asante.

zh.title: 女子足球为何成为国际足联计划的首个受害者

title: New EFL season gets under way... for four teams

content: For four teams, the EFL season gets under way this weekend in the preliminary round of the Carabao Cup.

title: Chris Cadden exits Hibs for 'more game time' with Aberdeen

content: Hibernian sell Chris Cadden to Scottish Premiership rivals Aberdeen, with the 29-year-old right-back seeking "a fresh challenge" and "more game time".

title: Liverpool's Jones argues with Szoboszlai after game

title: AC Milan and Italy great Baresi dies aged 66

content: AC Milan and Italy great Franco Baresi has died at the age of 66, the Italian club announces.

title: Asian confederation joins Uefa and Concacaf in opposing Fifa plan
summary: The Asian Football Confederation has joined UEFA and Concacaf in opposing FIFA's proposal to sell stakes in its competitions to private investors. The AFC stated it "stands in solidarity" with other confederations against the plan. This unified opposition reflects growing concerns about FIFA's commercialization efforts.
content: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) says it "stands in solidarity" with Uefa and Concacaf in opposition to Fifa's proposal to sell stakes in its competitions to private investors.

content: Hayden Mullins leaves his role as Fulham Under-21 boss to become the new head coach of League Two side Newport County.

content: Gianni Infantino has clashed with unions and European football, but after 10 years as Fifa president he remains in a powerful position.
